before.name: Committed Qty
before.description: Issue #18 -- this line's Qty unless its PO was withdrawn, in which case 0. The rule for which POs count toward a material's order book lives here, in one named field, rather than inside each Materials rollup's condition: a rollup condition is invisible in a schema dump, unreadable by code, and would have to be repeated per rollup. The & "" coerces the PO Status lookup (an array) to text so the comparison works.

after.name: Ordered Qty
after.description: This ordered item's Qty while its order is not withdrawn, and 0 once it is; Qty keeps what was ordered either way. What the screens call Ordered (#18; Committed Qty until #685). The rule for which orders count lives here, in one named field, rather than inside each Materials rollup's condition: a rollup condition is invisible in a schema dump, unreadable by code, and would have to be repeated per rollup. The & "" coerces the PO Status lookup (an array) to text so the comparison works.

before.name: Committed Qty
before.description: Issue #18 -- total quantity of this material across every PO line that has not been withdrawn, summed from PO Items.Committed Qty so the which-POs-count rule stays in one place. This is the material-axis figure the document-axis pages cannot give: PO detail answers "how much of this PO is invoiced", this answers "how much of this material is on order anywhere".

after.name: Ordered Qty
after.description: How much of this material is on order anywhere: the sum of PO Items.Ordered Qty over every ordered item of it, so a withdrawn order adds 0 where its Qty would not (#18; Committed Qty until #685). Summed from PO Items so the which-orders-count rule stays in one place. The material-axis figure the document-axis pages cannot give: an order's page answers "how much of this order is invoiced", this answers "how much of this material is on order anywhere".
